to: everyone: every socket on the game server, on both socket endpoints (`broadcast`). Only HARDCORE servers send it

fields.name: E
fields.description: The whole event state S. On HARDCORE it has `rewards` and `minutes` (see [rewards](#s-key-rewards) and [minutes](#s-key-minutes)).

fields.name: achiever
fields.description: The character who won a reward slot now. Absent in the update every 60 s.

confirm.note: On HARDCORE `init_server` replaces E with `{rewards, minutes}`, so E has no `schedule` there. `first_goo` is not in the initial `rewards` but a goo kill adds it; `first_wabbit` is in it but nothing fills it.

rewards.!participation: Every authorized account with a level 60+ character receives a participation award!

senders.what: `hardcore_loop` every 60 s: it sets `rewards.leader` to the highest-level character and decreases `minutes`. No `achiever`.
A first kill of `ent`, `stompy`, `franky`, `fvampire`, `mvampire`, `skeletor` or `goo` (the slot `first_<monster>`).
A first character of a class at level 70 (the slot `first_<class>_70`).
A first compound to level 5 or 6 (`accessory5`, `accessory6`).
A first upgrade to level 8 to 12 (`item8` to `item12`).
